time.expression: poly(input size), for fixed radius constant

notes: A sufficiently good preprocessed basis turns the basis-relative bound into polynomial-time decoding at radius c lambda_1(L)/n for any fixed constant c covered by the time bound. Advice construction is not charged.

extra.radius: c lambda_1(L)/n for a fixed constant c (O(lambda_1/n) historical regime)
extra.advice: A suitable Korkin–Zolotarev basis; polynomial-size advice
extra.preprocessing: Unbounded; supplying the good basis is essential
extra.model: Online query only; not an end-to-end polynomial BDD algorithm
